title: Group control: one remote drives two phones at once | VirtualPyTest
description:
Group control drives several devices with one remote. On the Device page, turn it on and pick the phones to drive. From one remote, open Chrome on two phones, type a web address once and scroll the page: every command reaches both at the same time, and each device confirms it.

Open source & free
